message.en:
We have a scheduled network maintenance in us-central2-a and us-central2-b:

* New instance creation will be disabled during this period
* Connectivity with the internet will be disrupted
* VMs will be temporarily unaccessible from the internet

Please plan for service interruption by backing up any necessary data or moving workloads to other regions temporarily.  
  
VMs will not be stopped during the maintenance window.

Thank you for your cooperation!
